name: html-inline-svg-materialized-box-size-carry
description: Materialized inline SVGs retain source box sizing while currentColor is resolved into the sanitized SVG file.

source_reference.notes: Distilled generic coverage for class-sized cover/map/logo SVGs whose inherited currentColor is resolved before SVG asset materialization.

legacy_comparison.reason: This upstream primitive fixture has no downstream legacy comparison.

input.content: <style>.cover-art{width:100%;max-width:320px;aspect-ratio:1;display:block}</style><main><svg class="cover-art" viewBox="0 0 500 500" role="img" aria-label="Cover art"><defs><linearGradient id="paint"><stop offset="0%" stop-color="currentColor"></stop><stop offset="100%" stop-color="#b8552a"></stop></linearGradient></defs><rect width="500" height="500" fill="url(#paint)"></rect></svg></main>
